<!-- closer-core/v1 followup-of=stranske/Orchestrator#1074@1075 -->
## Why
The remainder combines historical evidence recovery, real retrospective execution, live closer observation and unresolved acceptance-suite diagnosis; it exceeds one focused repair to the delivered tooling.
Source issue #1074; merged PR #1075 delivered: The merged work delivered read-only inventory and dispute-identity reconciliation tooling, historical receipt validation, and substantial synthetic retrospective and closer integration regressions with deliberate-fault controls. It also supplied behavioral evidence for existing empty-gate recovery, but did not complete real operational acceptance.

## Scope
- Correct completion metadata so delivered tooling is retained without representing operational acceptance as complete.
- Recover the original dispute identities and establish their provenance; reconcile against a read-only Brain inventory, recording one persisted shadow result or explicit identity-specific gap per requested dispute.
- Diagnose the 16 CLI failures individually. Distinguish stale timeout/schema expectations from cost, ordering and saved-state defects; fix only demonstrated defects or demonstrably obsolete expectations.
- Run all three issue-named acceptance tests on the exact evaluated source and perform the two required named-test mutations with byte-identical restoration.
- Execute the authenticated retrospective with authoritative outcome writes prohibited and retain case, role-run and cost provenance.
- Observe one real contested closer disposition and independently verify its persisted shadow record and unchanged authoritative outcomes.
- Reconcile the saved report and actual switch-review output with persisted case and cost records; document historical-object requirements for receipt tests and retain completed target-source CI evidence.

## Non-Goals
- Do not redo work that PR #1075 already delivered.

## Tasks
- [ ] Correct completion metadata so delivered tooling is retained without representing operational acceptance as complete.
- [ ] Recover the original dispute identities and establish their provenance; reconcile against a read-only Brain inventory, recording one persisted shadow result or explicit identity-specific gap per requested dispute.
- [ ] Diagnose the 16 CLI failures individually. Distinguish stale timeout/schema expectations from cost, ordering and saved-state defects; fix only demonstrated defects or demonstrably obsolete expectations.
- [ ] Run all three issue-named acceptance tests on the exact evaluated source and perform the two required named-test mutations with byte-identical restoration.
- [ ] Execute the authenticated retrospective with authoritative outcome writes prohibited and retain case, role-run and cost provenance.
- [ ] Observe one real contested closer disposition and independently verify its persisted shadow record and unchanged authoritative outcomes.
- [ ] Reconcile the saved report and actual switch-review output with persisted case and cost records; document historical-object requirements for receipt tests and retain completed target-source CI evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every authenticated requested dispute maps to a persisted shadow result or an explicit per-case evidence gap; exclusions, missing identities and inventory discrepancies are enumerated.
- [ ] All three named tests pass on the recorded source revision; outcome-write and uncontested-offer mutations fail the specified named tests, and exact restoration passes.
- [ ] A real contested closer observation identifies its target, source revision, shadow role record and unchanged authoritative outcomes.
- [ ] Saved summary and switch-review output match persisted counts and measured or explicitly unknown costs.
- [ ] Each retained CLI failure has a verified resolution or a specific evidence-backed explanation, with relevant checks passing.
- [ ] Completion metadata matches the resulting operational evidence.

## Implementation Notes
Verifier report (excerpt):

```
rite fails the second named test, uncontested offers fail the third, exact restoration passes) is met only for historical receipts, validated by scripts/verify_adjudicator_receipts.js and tests/test_adjudicator_receipts.js. The fresh controls are synthetic Node-test mutations, not the required named pytest mutations. The synthetic controls are attempt-noop-outcome-write, invoke-on-agreement, omit-closer-hook, discard-evidence-gap and invent-missing-cost. Each failed as expected and restoration passed.; Criterion 5 (a real contested closer disposition produces a shadow record while authoritative outcomes stay unchanged) is unmet. tests/test_adjudicator_closer_shadow.js and the closer-shadow receipt use a private Brain, a stub provider, a stubbed gate and panel, and a merge that always refuses. The receipt records operational_acceptance_complete=false. The 'no offer for an uncontested verdict' half is shown only synthetically, by the PASS, INCONCLUSIVE and null panel tests.; Criterion 6 (saved summary and switch-review line agree with persisted counts and measured or explicitly UNKNOWN costs) is unmet on real data. No canonical retrospective report exists. The batch test shows unknown costs staying null rather than becoming zero, but only on synthetic data. The baseline CLI suite (node tests/test_adjudicator_retro_cli.js) still has 16 failing tests out of 67 (chunk 2 baseline-cli log). They include shadow dispatch (600 !== 180), cost-measured counts, retry_pending/advice_* keys, run and attempt ordering, and the switch-review read-only test. They are unrepaired and unexplained, and they touch the report and switch-review agreement criterion.; Criterion 2 (empty initial and paginated gate responses record gaps without aborting the batch) has behavioral evidence but no identified implementation. The gate-and-inventory log (chunk 2) shows four passing cases: missing-initial-commit, missing-paginated-commit, null-initial-rollup and null-paginated-rollup. The discard-evidence-gap mutation fails as expected. However, no reviewed chunk contains the production Gate-read guard source. Chunk 4 states that none of its four test files covers the empty commits.nodes cases. The test file that holds the 'retro saves Gate gaps' cases is not identified. Reviewers need to confirm both the source change and the test location.; Completion metadata is inconsistent. The PR body still says 'Closes #1074', and the issue is closed. The body checks off the named-receipts task and the report and switch-review reconciliation task. The receipts support the first only as historical-receipt validation, and they do not demonstrate the second. The README files and the receipt publication block record that connector writes were rejected. The correction to 'Tracks #1074' therefore did not land, and merging risks premature closure of an issue whose operational criteria are incomplete.; The merge-commit verify.py failure is credibly substantiated as a stale collection floor (2605 collected against a floor of 2592, since reconciled), using the retained log excerpt and merge-verify.json. The CI run on the target commit is still in progress. This evidence has not been confirmed by a completed green run in the material supplied.; Minor: tests/test_adjudicator_receipts.js needs git objects for historical revisions and fails on shallow clones. The verifier trusts hard-coded SHAs and exempts the README from the byte-identity check. The READMEs are long and repeat blocker narrative.
```
